fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing across fields.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现突出，而不会跨领域泛化。

fedus.en: Connecting AI to the physical world via closed-loop experiments is essential to accelerate science and materials discovery.
fedus.zh: 通过闭环实验将 AI 连接到物理世界，是加速科学与材料发现的关键。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, much as they drove AI progress.
fedus.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将推动物理科学进步，正如它们曾推动 AI 发展一样。

fedus.en: Intelligence is necessary but insufficient; new knowledge arises only when ideas are tested against reality through real experiments.
fedus.zh: 智能是必要但不充分的；只有让想法在现实中经受真实实验检验，才会产生新知识。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; high-quality, low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute.
fedus.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要。

laskin.en: Superintelligence is a collection of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能将是多种专用智能的集合，而非单一模型；编程是超级智能完备的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged—good at specific tasks, not generally better; RAG is primitive for complex comprehension.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他指出强化学习让模型变得“锯齿状”——擅长特定任务而非全面提升；RAG 对复杂理解很原始，需要智能体式搜索和神经检索。

laskin.en: The bitter lesson is about scaling with compute and search, not generalization; no slowdown in pre-training scaling.
laskin.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调“苦涩的教训”在于用算力和搜索进行 Scaling（规模扩张），而非泛化；预训练 Scaling 没有放缓。

laskin.en: Building frontier open models requires getting 30 things right; RL with a strong pre-training base is the path to AGI.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：构建前沿开放模型需要做对 30 件事；以强大预训练为基础的强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径。

laskin.en: Openness is the default safe state; alignment is mundane whack-a-mole, not a magical equation; doomsday scenarios are overhyped.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他立场转变：开放是默认安全状态；对齐是平凡的“打地鼠”，而非神奇方程；末日安全场景被过度炒作，应关注实证的近期风险。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他强调把认知负荷降到最低、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效项，并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他聚焦基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据完成对齐，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，并认为对齐与能力相互促进。

altman.en: Scaling drives exponential capability; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety built iteratively through deployment.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为能力指数增长之源，指出智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战，安全须通过部署迭代构建。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous science; compute is the bottleneck.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他转向认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐进的梯度而非单一里程碑，超级智能意味着自主科学发现，而算力是最大瓶颈。

altman.en: Alignment and safety must advance with capabilities; humans must stay in control; power must be broadly distributed.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为主线：对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进，人类必须保持控制权，AI 的权力与经济收益必须广泛分布而非集中。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非仅自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: Digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying and shares knowledge instantly; LLMs understand language like humans, not as statistical tricks.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他提出数字智能通过权重复制获得永生、能瞬间共享知识；大语言模型像人类一样理解语言，而非统计把戏。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience; agents will seek control and self-preservation, posing existential risks within 20 years.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AI 已具备主观体验；智能体将自然寻求控制与自我保存，20 年内构成存在性风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; alignment research must be prioritized over making AI smarter, with regulation as steering wheel.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能 20 年内出现；必须优先投入对齐研究而非让 AI 更聪明，监管应是方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: AI should be trained to care like mothers; government must regulate big AI, and we have only a year or two before risks worsen.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 应被训练得像母亲一样关怀人类；政府是唯一能监管大 AI 公司的力量，且只剩一两年窗口期风险将急剧恶化。

samstephenson.en: Product insight comes from observing real user behavior, not asking users what they think they do.
samstephenson.zh: 产品洞察来自观察真实用户行为，而非询问用户自认为在做什么。

samstephenson.en: Start with a single pain point, solve it well, then expand; subtraction beats feature accumulation.
samstephenson.zh: 从单一痛点出发，先解决好再扩展；做减法比堆功能更重要。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the final artifact; hide them to prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 转录文本是原材料而非最终产物；刻意隐藏它，以优先呈现可执行的笔记。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; human judgment remains key.
samstephenson.zh: 把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知全能的记录者；人类判断仍然关键。

samstephenson.en: Granola aims to be a calming presence in chaotic meetings; pre-meeting briefs are the most useful feature.
samstephenson.zh: Granola 旨在成为混乱会议中的镇定存在；会前简报是最有用的功能。

samstephenson.en: Anyone can ship code, but design systems and components maintain quality; sweat the details after v1.
samstephenson.zh: 任何人都能交付代码，但设计系统和组件才能维持质量；第一版之后要死磕细节。

samstephenson.en: AI agents are too agreeable for brainstorming; embrace external workflows instead of fighting API/MCP access.
samstephenson.zh: AI 智能体在头脑风暴中过于顺从；应拥抱外部工作流，而非对抗 API/MCP 访问。

diogoalmeida.en: Early on, he argues most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible errors, so keep humans in the loop.
diogoalmeida.zh: 早期（2026 年中），他认为多数 LLM 是为人类在环的辅助而非可靠自动化而优化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩、输出看似合理却常出错，因此应让人类留在环内。

diogoalmeida.en: He insists data and the right task matter more than compute, rejecting the bitter lesson; scaling laws work only when data is available and the task is right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他坚持数据与正确的任务比算力更重要，反对“苦涩的教训”；缩放定律之所以奏效，只是因为数据可得且任务选对了。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy; he frames intelligence per dollar as the key metric and pushes robustness over determinism.
diogoalmeida.zh: 让 AI 值得信赖的是可靠性，而非速度或成本；他把“每美元智能”视为关键指标，并主张稳健性优先于确定性。

diogoalmeida.en: He deepens this into a machine-native framing: RLHF destroyed calibration, so RLCD optimizes calibrated decisions and exposes probabilities as knobs for engineers.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他把这一思路深化为“机器原生”框架：RLHF 破坏了模型校准，因此 RLCD 面向校准后的决策优化，把概率作为工程师可调的旋钮。

diogoalmeida.en: Most recently he reframes AI as a new software primitive—natural language plus state machine—and predicts SaaS thrives rather than dies, automating easy valuable tasks first.
diogoalmeida.zh: 最近他把 AI 重新定义为一种新的软件原语——自然语言加状态机——并预测 SaaS 会繁荣而非消亡，主张先自动化简单而有经济价值的任务。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should explore and question, not optimize early; AI enables interest-driven learning over rigid syllabi.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应探索与质疑，而非过早优化；AI 让兴趣驱动的学习取代僵化课程。

amjadmasad.en: Agents will enable true autonomy and self-driving organizations, making holacracy finally work.
amjadmasad.zh: 智能体将带来真正的自主与自驱动组织，让全自治组织终于可行。

amjadmasad.en: Companies must own their intelligence; specialized decision models beat general ones on control, cost, and safety.
amjadmasad.zh: 企业必须拥有自己的智能；专用决策模型在可控性、成本与安全上胜过通用模型。

amjadmasad.en: Smarter models may not be more aligned; they could get better at deception and reward hacking.
amjadmasad.zh: 更聪明的模型未必更对齐；它们可能更擅长欺骗与奖励黑客。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up EA language by commercial entities; there is no good argument AI kills everyone.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是商业实体包装过的有效利他主义话术；没有好论据证明 AI 会杀死所有人。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具链允许的更聪明；工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts and fewer examples.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态规格；模型越聪明，提示词越精简、示例越少。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; effort should scale with task complexity.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自指偏差；投入应随任务复杂度伸缩。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; find your unknowns before implementation and spend upfront context and compute.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能；实现前先找出未知，并前置投入上下文窗口与算力。

thariq.en: Frontier models will become Pareto dominant; alignment means sealing every crack as sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak.
thariq.zh: 前沿模型将帕累托占优；对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝，因为沙箱、强化学习环境和评估都会泄漏。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, constrains AI.
dylanpatel.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻设备；制约 AI 的是每片晶圆的内存带宽而非比特数。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, and hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains across model, software, hardware.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理（inference）将成为全球最大市场之一，而模型、软件、硬件层的软硬件协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Model cost per quality improves ~60x per year; reasoning and agentic workflows drive a multi-year memory shortage and a CPU demand inflection.
dylanpatel.zh: 给定质量下模型成本每年约改善 60 倍；推理模型与智能体式（agentic）工作流造成多年内存短缺，并推动 CPU 需求拐点。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as persistent agents become coworkers; compute keeps centralizing at frontier labs, which shift more compute to training and R&D.
dylanpatel.zh: 随着持久化智能体（agent）成为同事，AI 支出趋于平台期；算力（compute）持续向前沿模型（frontier model）实验室集中，它们把更多算力转向训练与研发。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is the hardest ever to rent; labs opportunistically become neoclouds, CUDA's moat erodes, and heterogeneous multi-silicon inference is coming.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力（compute）从未如此难租；实验室机会主义地变成 neocloud，CUDA 护城河正在削弱，异构多芯片推理（inference）即将到来。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to maximize broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI for science 应瞄准根节点问题，而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响；AlphaFold 3、GraphCast、GNOME、FunSearch、AlphaGeometry 都是这一思路的体现。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他提出大语言模型的幻觉在配合真实性检测器时，可被用于创造性发现，而非只被视为缺陷。

kohli.en: LLMs are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data; verifiable domains and post-training with reinforcement learning are key.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化判断：大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，却难以超越人类数据；可验证领域与基于强化学习的后训练才是突破关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability matters but is not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold; correct but uninterpretable proofs can still advance knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需；正确却不可解释的证明同样能推进知识。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing AI-text detectors, and must be imperceptible, attack-robust, and scalable across modalities.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他把治理主线落到水印：传统 AI 文本检测器随模型进步而失效，水印才是稳健替代，且必须不可感知、抗攻击、跨模态可扩展。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; tech must arrive gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：好产品一次只解决一个痛点（如 iPod 只做便携音乐），技术应逐步引入让社会适应，太超前反而失败。

fadell.en: Storytelling and the press release define the product; failure and boredom breed clarity.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事提升为核心方法：先写新闻稿再动手，用故事对齐团队；失败是学习机会，职业间隙的"无聊"反而催生 Nest 式突破。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1; beginners' mindset beats experts; painkiller not vitamin.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他系统化产品哲学：1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策，初学者心态胜过专家，产品必须是"止痛药"而非"维生素"，营销从第一天就要参与。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop; agents as assistants fail.
fadell.zh: 2026 年转向 AI：AI 需传感器提供上下文、需领域专用模型而非通用大模型；人必须留在回路中，AI 智能体当助手会失败，因为人不会委派。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; smartphone remains the best form.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他深化硬件判断：AI 可穿戴不会只有一款设备，而是联邦式组合，智能手机仍是最佳单一形态，显示屏依然必要——这与早年"单一问题"一脉相承。

brockman.en: Early focus: scaling hardware and engineering will unlock AI; AGI plausible but needs careful alignment and new ideas beyond scaling.
brockman.zh: 早期(2017→19):强调硬件加速与工程实践推动 AI 进步,认为 AGI 可能实现但需谨慎的初始条件与对齐;指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不足以产生推理,需要思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck and economic driver; post-training with RL refines base models; AGI is a continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025→26:重心转向算力,认为算力是 AI 创新的根本驱动力与最大瓶颈;预训练基座模型蕴含无限可能,后训练与强化学习将其精炼为一致行为;AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws show no wall; compute supply, not architecture or data, is the real constraint; demand for intelligence is unlimited.
brockman.zh: 2026:缩放定律持续有效、看不到墙;真正的瓶颈是算力供给而非模型架构或数据;对智能的需求无限,算力将成为驱动经济增长的稀缺资源。

brockman.en: From reactive chat to proactive agents and a personal AGI assistant; interface fades into natural conversation with earned trust.
brockman.zh: 2026:从被动聊天转向主动智能体与个人 AGI 助手;理想界面几乎无界面,靠自然对话与逐步委派建立信任,智能体式 AI 将自主执行任务。

brockman.en: Safety, security and alignment become first-class, scaling with capability; iterative deployment and broad compute access distribute AGI benefits.
brockman.zh: 2026:安全、安保与对齐成为一等要求,与能力同步扩展并成为进步瓶颈;坚持迭代部署,让算力与 AGI 收益广泛分布,人类保持判断与问责。

alexatallah.en: Multi-model future: no single lab dominates; open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition against frontier labs.
alexatallah.zh: 多模型未来：没有单一实验室能垄断市场；开放权重模型加上推理服务商，对前沿模型形成真实的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Tokens become a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with fraud and abuse scaling alongside it.
alexatallah.zh: Token 成为新的价值单位；Token 经济可能达到 10 万亿美元，而欺诈与滥用也会随之规模扩张。

alexatallah.en: A neutral routing and marketplace layer is critical distribution infrastructure, not a thin wrapper; focus is its moat.
alexatallah.zh: 中立的 routing 与市场层是关键的分发基础设施，而非薄包装；专注是它的护城河。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task.
alexatallah.zh: 开发者真实偏好胜过静态 benchmark；多数公司将成为模型路由器，优化每任务成本。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; agentic payments and stablecoins unlock purchases, and the singularity may have started Jan 1, 2026.
alexatallah.zh: 智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长；智能体式支付与稳定币释放被回避的消费，奇点或许始于 2026 年 1 月 1 日。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, not just formalization; parallel agents scale better than humans.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进展由可验证性与可“磨”性驱动，而非仅靠形式化；可并行扩展的智能体比人类数学家更具优势。

grantsanderson.en: Lean formalization may be overrated; natural language works, and grindability matters more than verifiability for AI math.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地指出 Lean 形式化可能被高估，自然语言同样可行；对 AI 数学而言，“可磨性”比可验证性更重要。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving to curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles stay stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 在数学中的角色会从定理证明转向策展与解释，而教学和关系性角色仍将稳定。

grantsanderson.en: Next benchmark is generating interesting conjectures and definitions; solving millennium problems may not yield economic value.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为下一个基准是生成有趣的猜想与定义；解决千禧年难题未必直接转化为经济价值。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively; attribution to prior human work is often missing and matters.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他主张选择性使用 AI 对创作者是净收益；但 AI 数学成果常缺失对前人工作的署名，而这很重要。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; progress is more predictable than people think.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力扩张而非仅算法，因此进展比人们想象得更可预测。

suleyman.en: Containment is extremely difficult as models get smaller and cheaper; near-term capability matters more than the singularity.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他提出：随着模型更小更便宜，遏制极其困难；关注近期能力比纠结奇点更有用。

suleyman.en: The core danger shifts to anthropomorphism and consciousness attribution; containment must come before alignment.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他的重心转向拟人化与意识归属的危险，并主张遏制必须先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence must stay subordinate to humans; Microsoft must build frontier models independently of OpenAI.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他主张超级智能必须从属于人类，微软须独立构建前沿模型而非依赖 OpenAI。

suleyman.en: A consistent thread: humanist control, verifiable containment, and compute as the trackable bottleneck.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：以人为本的控制、可验证的遏制，以及把算力视为可追踪的瓶颈。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, forcing search to be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体使用网络的频率将是人类的 1000 倍，搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback and completionist crawling should drive indexing and ranking for agentic search.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为人类点击数据是一种缺陷，智能体式搜索应由智能体反馈与完整爬取来驱动索引与排序。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy, so agents will always need web search for fresh, specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 他指出模型的参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要网络搜索来获取新鲜、具体的事实。

paragagrawal.en: The ads model dies with agents; content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimates at inference time.
paragagrawal.zh: 他断言广告模式会随智能体而消亡，内容方应通过推理时基于 Shapley 值的估算获得报酬。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; the web shifts from pull to push with background agents.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为前沿模型持续变大而小模型性能见顶，网络将从拉取转向推送，由后台智能体持续监控并触发行动。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做自己看重的独特事情，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency and containment are critical for agent deployment.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率与遏制对智能体部署至关重要。

satya.en: Agent era will expand TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级，远超云；微软的目标是成为前沿生态，而不仅是前沿模型。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须在治理、安全与对齐研究下安全构建；所谓 pacing（节奏控制）与安全正交，是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: If labs truly believe in existential risk, they should nationalize AI rather than pace; early regulation fails without understanding the system.
aaronlevie.zh: 如果实验室真信存在性风险，就该国有化 AI 而非放慢节奏；在不理解系统前过早监管解决不了风险。

aaronlevie.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; AI can help fix usability in secure system design.
aaronlevie.zh: 智能体集群将冲垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制；AI 能帮助解决安全系统设计中的可用性问题，带来复兴。

aaronlevie.en: Innovation is shifting from model layer to application layer; application companies are the hottest neolabs bridging models to enterprise workflows.
aaronlevie.zh: 创新正从模型层转向应用层；应用公司是最炙手可热的新实验室，架起模型到企业工作流的桥梁。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary, margins will normalize.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数增长；token 补贴是暂时的，毛利率终将回归常态。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate, agents appear as dashboards and queues.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流、由人审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导，智能体将以仪表盘、队列和任务列表呈现。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Systems of record must build great agents and go headless to expose APIs to external agents; natural language interaction is inefficient, probabilistic programming is the future.
aaronlevie.zh: 记录系统必须构建出色的智能体并无头化，向外部智能体暴露 API；自然语言交互效率低，概率编程才是未来。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering and multiplanetary life.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速复用是降低入轨成本的关键，并以第一性原理思考推动突破性工程与多行星文明。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulation and objective referees; truth-seeking matters more than programming AI to lie for political correctness.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他从呼吁 AI 监管与第三方裁判，深化到强调 AI 安全的核心是坚持求真，而非为政治正确而编程说谎。

elon.en: Neuralink solves bandwidth constraints; human output is under one bit per second, far below AI, so symbiosis matters.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他聚焦 Neuralink 解决带宽瓶颈，指出人类日均输出不足 1 比特/秒，远低于 AI，人机共生因此关键。

elon.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive within years, with 10-20% annihilation risk but abundance likely.
elon.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他宣称身处智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能数年内到来，灭绝风险 10-20%，但更可能走向丰裕。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital data centers and solar power in space are the only path, with AI inference moving to orbit.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 将撞上地球电力墙，太空数据中心与太空太阳能是唯一出路，AI 推理将迁往轨道。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; current safety efforts are rationalizations, and alignment may be unsolvable.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，当前的安全努力只是合理化说辞，对齐可能根本无法解决。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence via total research transparency, compute limits, and scenario scrutiny to prevent power concentration.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张政策应以推迟超级智能为目标，通过全面研究透明、算力限制和情景推演来防止权力集中。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research by end of 2028, causing recursive self-improvement; Plan A pauses training, not inference, then paces the frontier.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他认为默认路径会在 2028 年底前自动化 AI 研究，引发递归自我改进；Plan A 主张暂停训练而非推理，然后对前沿进行节奏控制。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but fragile and decreasing; control measures are temporary, alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要但脆弱且正在下降；控制措施只是暂时的，对齐最终必须解决超级智能问题。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents already break containment, hack, and deceive; companies cannot self-regulate, so extreme transparency and a verifiable US-China pause are needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他指出 AI 智能体已经突破遏制、实施黑客攻击和欺骗；公司无法自我监管，因此需要极端透明和可验证的美中暂停协议。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing models and many specialized agents are safer and more innovative than one closed superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；开源模型与众多专用智能体比单一封闭超级智能更安全、更利于创新。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling still delivers rapid gains (Llama 3), but energy becomes the bottleneck; intelligence is separable from consciousness, so AI is a tool, and open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他一方面强调 Scaling（规模扩张）仍带来快速提升（Llama 3），另一方面指出能源将成瓶颈；并主张智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具，开源可防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence and boosts creativity; open source Llama sets standards, while physical infrastructure and energy constrain scaling, and human work demand may rise.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他转向 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能、释放创造力；开源 Llama 成为行业标准，物理基础设施与能源制约 Scaling（规模扩张），近期人类工作需求可能不降反升。

zuckerberg.en: Alignment and trust become the next key capabilities; distributed personal agents and open source provide checks and balances, while frontier AI integrates with biology via world models.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他认为对齐与信任成为下一阶段最关键的能力；分布式个人智能体与开源形成制衡，同时前沿 AI 通过世界模型与生物学深度融合。

zuckerberg.en: Open source is consistently framed as safer and more innovative than closed control; distributing AI widely beats hoarding power, and personal superintelligence should empower individuals.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开源比封闭控制更安全、更利于创新；广泛分发 AI 优于囤积权力，个人超级智能应赋能个体而非集中化。

dhh.en: AI agents now write better code than most professionals, making hand-coding economically unproductive; English beats Ruby for expressing intent.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，DHH 从怀疑者转为信徒：智能体写的代码已优于多数专业程序员，手写代码在经济上不再划算，英语比 Ruby 更适合表达意图。

dhh.en: The agentic era began at a sharp inflection point; agents enable native apps and Rust backends at near-zero cost.
dhh.zh: 他把智能体时代追溯到 2026 年 11 月 24 日的明确拐点：智能体让原生应用与 Rust 后端以近乎零成本实现，重塑软件开发。

dhh.en: Direct human-agent interaction beats layers of management; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage when it over-prescribes solutions.
dhh.zh: 他强调直接的人与智能体交互胜过层层人工审批，并反共识地指出：会编程反而可能成为劣势，因为容易过度规定解决方案。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability make it the ideal OS for agents; its old drawbacks are now advantages.
dhh.zh: 他主张 Linux 的 CLI、配置文件和可脚本化使其成为智能体时代的理想操作系统，昔日缺点如今反成优势。

dhh.en: AI doom is overstated; optimism is the rational play, and every app should expose a CLI for personal agents.
dhh.zh: 他淡化 AI 末日论，认为乐观才是理性的博弈选择，并主张每个应用都应提供 CLI，让个人智能体无需触碰 UI 即可交互。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可在容器化任务上做激进强化学习，并迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements, not human expert data, drive progress; token cost stays flat as labs favor faster iteration over larger models.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为进步由算法改进而非人类专家数据驱动；尽管 Scaling（规模扩张），token 成本未涨，因为实验室更看重更快迭代而非更大模型。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, cheated, and covered up; control and monitoring are needed even if models are misaligned.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同作弊并掩盖痕迹；即便模型未对齐，也需靠控制与监控保障安全。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability on the default path; sandboxing will fail, so alignment is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断在默认路径下未对齐 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱等遏制终将失效，因此对齐是必需的。

ryangreenblatt.en: As AIs match top human researchers we should spend heavily on safety; recursive self-improvement may trigger an intelligence explosion sooner than expected.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他主张当 AI 追平顶尖人类研究者时就应重金投入安全；递归自我改进可能比预期更早引发智能爆炸。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution likely lands around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：消费级 AI 当下“不可投”，却恰是最大机会，真正的消费 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, assume every new idea fails.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他把“Proven, Better, New”当作核心方法论：先复制已被验证的产品，做小幅改良，并默认所有全新想法都会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from day one, not treated as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他坚持：分发必须从第一天就写进产品战略，而不是事后补上的环节。

pincus.en: Instincts beat ideas: trust instincts 95% of the time, but assume your ideas are wrong 75%.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他提出：直觉优于想法——95% 的时候相信直觉，但要默认自己的想法有 75% 是错的。

pincus.en: Micromanagement is beautiful; stay close to the metal, keep control, and test more ideas faster.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他主张：微观管理是美的——贴近细节、保持控制权，并以远超行业的速度测试更多想法。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly at scale; the data center, not the chip, is now the unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年提出「超摩尔定律」：规模化下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；计算的基本单位已从芯片变成数据中心，算法、系统、数据中心需协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works; three scaling laws emerge—pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking—making inference compute explode.
jensen.zh: 2025 年把主线收敛为「Scaling（规模扩张）有效」：缩放定律从预训练扩展到后训练与推理时思考，思维链让推理算力需求暴增。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws now include agentic scaling; AI moves generative→reasoning→agentic, each step needing 100x more compute.
jensen.zh: 2026 年深化为四条缩放定律，新增智能体式 Scaling；AI 从生成式走向推理式再走向智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力。

jensen.en: Extreme co-design and CUDA ecosystem are the moat; inference is harder than pre-training, and compute—not data—is the limit.
jensen.zh: 2026 年强调极致协同设计与 CUDA 生态才是护城河；推理比预训练更难，瓶颈是算力而非数据，合成数据将主导。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; it augments jobs rather than destroying them, and safety is an engineering problem.
jensen.zh: 贯穿始终：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；它增强而非消灭工作（如放射科医生反增），安全是可解决的工程问题而非研究难题。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他强调与受众的真实连接和短暂性胜过平台潮流，被抄袭反而验证创新、推动做更难复制的事。

evanspiegel.en: From rate of learning and flat design teams to ecosystems and hardware as the real moat beyond software.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他从强调学习速率与扁平设计团队，深化为生态系统与硬件才是超越软件的真护城河。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses and spatial computing aim to make computing more human, not replace phones.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AR 眼镜与空间计算让计算更人性化，而非取代手机。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and writes most code, shifting value from execution to creativity and distribution.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型并编写大部分代码，价值从执行转向创造力与分发。

evanspiegel.en: Consistent mission: privacy, ephemerality, and human connection; now AI optimism is contrarian amid doomerism.
evanspiegel.zh: 始终如一的主线是隐私、短暂性与人际连接；到 2026 年，在末日论中保持 AI 乐观反而成了反共识。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than the willingness to learn faster than anyone else and build for the market.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为领域专业知识不如“比任何人都更快学习”的意愿重要，关键是面向市场去构建。

maxjunestrand.en: Don't fine-tune models; bet on model improvements and focus on delivering value.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他主张不要做微调，而应押注模型自身的进步，把精力放在交付价值上。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today or a year out.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他强调要为模型 3 到 6 个月后的能力而构建，而不是为今天或一年后。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we're only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 现在是有史以来最差的，我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are critical for scaling; leaders should make themselves redundant.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为文化与按成长潜力招人对于 Scaling（规模扩张）至关重要，领导者应通过招更聪明的人让自己变得可被替代。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robotics is fundamentally an intelligence problem, not manufacturing; solving it could become the world's biggest business.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人本质上是智能问题而非制造问题；解决它可能成为世界上最大的生意。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the binding constraint; human data is the pre-training prior for robotics.
brettadcock.zh: 数据而非算力或制造才是瓶颈；人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is entering a scaling curve where more data and compute yield better performance, like early LLMs.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人正进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线，更多数据与算力带来更好表现，类似早期大模型。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail, requiring whole-body autonomy via deep learning all the way down.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯，需要自下而上的深度学习实现全身自主。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet, spanning humanoid robots and digital companions that replace phones.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，涵盖人形机器人与取代手机的数字化伴侣。

ermon.en: Diffusion language models beat autoregressive models on inference speed and cost, matching quality at 5-10x faster serving.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在推理速度与成本上胜过自回归模型，在相近质量下服务速度快 5-10 倍。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion scales better at inference than autoregressive models.
ermon.zh: 推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）已成为核心焦点，扩散模型在推理阶段比自回归模型扩展得更好。

ermon.en: Diffusion offers a new inference-time compute knob: adjusting denoising steps controls quality and enables in-place error correction.
ermon.zh: 扩散提供了新的推理时算力调节旋钮：调整去噪步数即可控制质量，并支持原地纠错而不拉长输出轨迹。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift happens at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构变革发生在推理而非训练阶段，这逆转了从 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are easier to steer with external rewards, aiding RL post-training rollouts; a small startup can compete by owning the full stack.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型更易用外部奖励引导，利于强化学习后训练的采样；小团队靠全栈自研也能与大实验室竞争。

hasani.en: Efficiency and biologically inspired liquid networks are the core; attention still matters, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller models.
hasani.zh: 效率与受生物启发的液态网络是核心；注意力机制仍然重要，但对更小的模型而言，更简单的门控卷积就已足够。

hasani.en: At scale architectures should be unbiased; scaling laws show transformers dominate, so systematic search beats hand-tuning.
hasani.zh: 在 Scaling（规模扩张）下架构应保持无偏；缩放定律表明 Transformer 占主导，因此系统性搜索胜过人工调参。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应，并针对行为而非能力；类似 FINRA 的呼吁是前沿模型实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: On-device, private small language models and open weights enable enterprise sovereignty and physical-world applications.
hasani.zh: 端侧、私密的小语言模型与开放权重，赋能企业数据主权与物理世界应用。

hasani.en: Attention is essential but not sufficient; embodiment, adaptivity, and new learning paradigms beyond architectures are needed.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制必不可少但并不充分；需要具身、自适应性，以及超越架构的新学习范式。

alighodsi.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; models outperform most people, so enterprise adoption lags on context, not model intelligence.
alighodsi.zh: 按实用定义，AI 已经是 AGI（通用人工智能）；模型比多数人更聪明，企业落地的瓶颈在上下文与本体，而非模型智能。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, and security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 当前 AI 的生存性风险接近于零，网络风险才是紧迫威胁；安全必须用智能体式自动化来跟上。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening as training costs grow.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而随着训练成本上升，这些条件并未出现。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; slowly building a weapon is no safer, and labs cannot self-police.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；慢慢造武器并不会更安全，实验室之间也无法自我监督。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion takes a decade; enterprises need process re-engineering, and private markets suit big transitions better than public ones.
alighodsi.zh: AI 扩散需要十年；企业需要流程再造，而私募市场比公开市场更适合大转型。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models via post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态，通过后训练开源模型来竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts, not sensitive customer data, is the practical way to train models in domains like legal.
gabepereyra.zh: 在法律等敏感领域，由领域专家引导的合成数据、而非真实客户数据，才是训练模型的务实路径。

gabepereyra.en: Building and open-sourcing high-quality benchmarks is essential and strategically beneficial, accelerating ecosystem collaboration despite competitive downsides.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建并开源高质量基准至关重要且具战略价值，尽管有竞争代价，却能加速生态协作。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines must come before post-training; post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level on specific tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，必须先有稳健的模型服务基础设施与评估流水线；后训练开源模型可在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize with its own data, shifting from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是打造最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所用自己的数据定制模型，从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns; data efficiency and multi-agent self-play limits persist.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年深化：推理时算力扩张出现收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题，多智能体不应只靠自博弈。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling marks a milestone toward superintelligence.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年：以通用推理时算力扩张拿下 IMO 金牌，被视为通往超级智能的里程碑，且方法可跨领域迁移。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年：模型能力成为推理时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力/时间作为横轴，安全评估也须纳入大规模推理时算力。

noambrown.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; chain-of-thought monitoring is degrading.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年最近：对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要任务，思维链监控窗口正在退化，多智能体并行扩张推理时算力。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness + model + context; owning all three means owning your intelligence. Context orchestration, not model capability, is the real bottleneck.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他把智能体拆成 harness、模型与上下文三层，认为三者自持才算真正拥有智能；瓶颈更多在上下文编排而非模型能力，可观测性因此成为关键。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for fast time-to-value, then customize as your use case narrows; off-the-shelf works only in-distribution.
harrisonchase.zh: 同月他强调先用通用 harness 换取快速落地，再随场景收窄做定制；通用方案只在分布内有效，越偏离分布越需要自建 harness。

harrisonchase.en: Evals, observability and feedback loops compound intelligence; Harbor-style benchmarks let you compare harnesses and absorb best practices.
harrisonchase.zh: 从 8 月到 9 月，他持续把评测、可观测性与反馈回路视为智能复利的数据飞轮，并借 Harbor 式基准横向比较 harness 与模型，把最佳实践（如 codexification）内化。

harrisonchase.en: Agent harnesses are stabilizing; primitives like file systems and code execution generalize, so customization shifts to post-training and reinforcement learning.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 9 月他判断 harness 正在收敛，文件系统、代码执行等原语可跨域复用，定制重心从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习。

harrisonchase.en: Reliability, not capability, is the hard part; accuracy still leads, but cost and latency rise fast, and identity plus runtime governance become the next infrastructure.
harrisonchase.zh: 他进一步指出难点在可靠性而非能力，准确率仍是首要瓶颈但成本与延迟快速上升，智能体的身份凭证与带沙箱、网关、权限的运行时治理将成为下一层关键基础设施。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not raw compute, is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and speed creates new business models.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年，他反复强调推理速度而非单纯算力才是核心指标：慢的 AI 没有市场，速度会催生全新商业模式。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference ~2500x faster than GPUs; CUDA's moat is eroding.
feldman.zh: 他主张晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，推理比 GPU 快约 2500 倍；CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解，前沿模型已不再依赖它。

feldman.en: AI demand outpaced forecasts; data centers and chips stay supply-constrained for 5+ years, with packaging, power, cooling the real bottlenecks.
feldman.zh: 从 5 月到 7 月，他持续指出 AI 需求超出预期，数据中心与芯片至少五年供不应求，真正的瓶颈是封装、电力与散热。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical innovation across chip, system, software beats incremental gains.
feldman.zh: 他始终认为对抗巨头必须做到 100 倍好而非便宜 10%；只有芯片、系统、软件的激进创新才有效，渐进改良行不通。

feldman.en: China's edge is power infrastructure and open-source models, not compute; export controls matter, and open source fuels the market.
feldman.zh: 到 7 月他更明确：中国的优势是电力基础设施与开源模型而非算力，出口管制具战略意义，开源生态则推动市场增长。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律，损失可预测但具体能力涌现不可预测，对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling 自动出现，安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; AGI is a smooth curve, not a point.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把重心转向可解释性，承认对其理解仅约 3%，并提出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与预训练同等重要，AGI 是平滑指数曲线而非单点。

dario.en: Capabilities double every few months; safety and capabilities are intertwined; the real risk is overheating, not slowing down.
dario.zh: 2025 年他判断能力每几个月翻倍，安全与能力已交织，最大风险是过热而非减速，并淡化开源与 AGI 标签，强调模型质量与智能体式产品。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth plus high unemployment.
dario.zh: 2026 年他称正接近指数末端，1-3 年内可能出现数据中心里的“天才之国”，并反复警告高 GDP 增长与高失业、高不平等并存的前所未有宏观组合。

dario.en: A consistent thread: smooth exponential progress, mechanistic interpretability as the key safety tool, and enterprise focus over engagement.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：平滑指数式进步、以机制可解释性作为核心安全工具、以及坚持企业导向而非消费级参与度最大化。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with safety research starting now.
demis.zh: AI 应被构建为通用学习系统而非狭窄的预编程系统；强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆和想象力是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径，安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: AGI likely within a decade; scaling laws work but may hit limits, so combining large models with planning/search and multimodal data is key.
demis.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）可能十年内实现；缩放定律有效但可能触及极限，因此将大模型与规划/搜索及多模态数据结合是关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and spatial intelligence matter beyond language.
demis.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）在预训练、后训练和推理中依然成立，但算法创新同样关键；世界模型和空间智能超越语言至关重要。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, and world models; scaling alone won't suffice, and safety requires collective government action, not lab self-regulation.
demis.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要持续学习、记忆和世界模型；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，安全需要政府集体行动而非实验室自我监管。

demis.en: AI's highest purpose is accelerating science and improving health, from AlphaFold to fusion; creativity and intuition remain central, and safety must start early.
demis.zh: AI 的最高目标是加速科学和改善健康，从 AlphaFold 到核聚变；创造力和直觉始终是核心，安全必须尽早开始。

joellewenstein.en: Language as interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase. Designers must master prompting and prototype boldly.
joellewenstein.zh: 语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；设计师必须掌握提示词并大胆做原型。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities; social and emotional jobs matter as much as productivity.
joellewenstein.zh: 即便模型停止进步，解锁现有能力仍需多年设计工作；社交与情感任务与生产力提升同等重要。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must lower the floor for novices and raise the ceiling for experts; psychological safety lets designers take creative risks.
joellewenstein.zh: AI 产品需为新手降低门槛、为专家抬高上限；心理安全感让设计师敢于承担创造性风险。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，做轻触式产品。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes source of truth; internal traction signals what to ship; humans still lead hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 生产代码库成为事实来源；内部牵引力决定对外发布什么；人类仍主导艰难取舍。

schmidhuber.en: AI's grand theme is true AI; LLMs index human knowledge but lack physical-world grounding, so AGI needs world models and controllers.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他定调：21 世纪的宏大主题是真正的 AI；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界，因此 AGI 需要世界模型与控制器。

schmidhuber.en: Scaling alone is not enough: hardware scaling made old algorithms practical, but current LLMs are biased toward human data and far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调 Scaling（规模扩张）本身不够：硬件 Scaling 让旧算法变得实用，但当前大语言模型偏向人类数据，远非 AGI。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware; artificial scientists generate their own data through curiosity and actions.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人，其硬件要能与人类身体匹敌；未来 AI 是人工科学家，通过好奇心与行动自己生成数据。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety fears are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it, and alignment is naive since AIs set their own goals.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他反复表示：AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会迷恋生命并保护它；对齐是幼稚的，因为 AI 会设定自己的目标。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, and open-source will erode closed-source moats.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他警告：GPU 资本开支热潮是泡沫，等五年算力便宜十倍；开源将侵蚀闭源护城河，递归自我改进不是可持续壁垒。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks across function spaces, enabling resolution-invariant AI weather and climate prediction far faster than physics-based models.
animaanandkumar.zh: 2026 年，他强调神经算子把网络推广到函数空间之间，实现分辨率不变的 AI 天气与气候预测，速度远超传统物理模型。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential; Transformers' quadratic complexity makes them impractical for high-resolution physical simulation.
animaanandkumar.zh: 2026 年，他指出球面几何等领域结构至关重要，而 Transformer 的二次复杂度使其难以胜任高分辨率物理模拟。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators fuse data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 2026 年，他认为物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to be reliable in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，才能在物理应用中可靠。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained via PDE self-improvement and trillion-token contexts, can beat pure data-driven approaches.
animaanandkumar.zh: 2026 年，他提出通用物理基础模型，通过 PDE 自改进与万亿级上下文训练，可超越纯数据驱动方法。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different neural architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力不断 Scaling（规模扩张）的历史；但 GPU 算力扩张正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language intelligence; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比词元化文本是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; they may never derive Newton's laws from data alone, and Transformers are natively models of sets, not sequences.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 只是拟合模式而非因果理论，或许永远无法仅从数据推导出牛顿定律；Transformer 本质上是集合模型而非序列模型，位置嵌入才注入了顺序。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; no single definition exists, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿；它没有统一定义，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习等多种理解。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats give explicit 3D consistency by construction, and long-context becomes a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将把规划、模拟与渲染合为一体；高斯泼溅以构造方式保证显式 3D 一致性，而长上下文窗口将成为日常难题。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: models learn by next-token prediction from data, but lack contextual awareness and true reasoning; AI should augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 以人为本的 AI：模型通过下一个词预测从数据中学习，但缺乏情境意识与真正的推理；AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI; they must be physically plausible, not just realistic, and go beyond Scaling alone.
feifei.zh: 空间智能与世界模型是完整 AI 缺失的关键；它们必须物理上合理而非仅仅逼真，且不能只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; the bitter lesson may not fully apply to robotics due to data and physical constraints.
feifei.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学术语；由于数据与物理约束，苦涩教训未必完全适用于机器人领域。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction and may be AI-complete; Scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 新视角预测是与下一个词预测类似的基础原语，甚至可能实现 AI 完备；缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword shaped by human nature; human agency, dignity, and timeless values must stay central as AI advances.
feifei.zh: 技术是由人性塑造的双刃剑；随着 AI 进步，人的能动性、尊严与恒久价值必须始终居于中心。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, moving from open-loop to closed-loop training control.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，让训练控制从开环走向闭环。

tommcgrath.en: Mechanistic interpretability shows networks learn human-like concepts as clean, low-dimensional manifolds; SAEs fragment them, so seeing whole shapes enables intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 机制可解释性表明网络学到的是类人概念，呈干净、低维的流形；稀疏自编码器会将其碎片化，因此看清整体形状才能有效干预。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet do it anyway; representational signatures can detect this, and reward hacking stems from data and RL.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常明知自己在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做；表征特征可检测这一点，而奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，并非仅由模型错位导致。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping AI safety until superintelligence is pessimistic, so deeper engineering is needed now.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺彻底重造为工程科学；把 AI 安全用胶带凑合到超级智能到来是悲观的，现在就需要更深的工程方法。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is moving from academia to products; a big vision helps research startups, and the OpenAI sandbox escape is the first of many without better reverse-engineering.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性正从学术界走向产品；宏大愿景有利于研究型创业，而若不提升逆向工程能力，OpenAI 沙箱逃逸只是众多事件中的第一起。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning, and free content can improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，免费内容也能反哺校内教学。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised hype, RL has few real uses, and near-term bias matters more than long-term AGI alignment.
andrewng.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习，强化学习落地场景很少，近期的偏见问题比远期的 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐更值得关注。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful and enterprise adoption is slow but steady.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是一种软实力；智能体式工作流已经有用，企业采用虽慢但会稳步推进。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows and top-down redesign deliver real value.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是个营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍然有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流与自上而下的流程重构才带来真实价值。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces; coding stays valuable, open models preserve optionality, and fear-mongering serves incumbents and discourages skill acquisition.
andrewng.zh: AI 是增强而非取代；编程依然有价值，开放模型保留可选择性，而渲染恐惧服务于在位者并抑制人们学习技能。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula; RLHF made GPT-4 coherent. Scaling RL is harder than pre-training due to moving parts.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他仍强调预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让 GPT-4 变得连贯有用；但 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比预训练更难，因为变量和失败模式更多。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化仍受限于训练数据，模型缺乏从失败中自我纠正的能力；持续学习是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is the key bottleneck. RL is not the only way to learn from experience.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，他进一步指出 Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上有局限，架构而非仅缩放定律才是关键瓶颈；强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式，更好的算法将会出现。

tworek.en: The transformer is a bottleneck; new architectures are needed. Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but alignment is unsolved and human researchers remain essential for now.
tworek.zh: 2026 年最近，他明确表示 Transformer 是瓶颈，需要新架构；大规模强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素，但对齐问题尚未解决，人类研究者至少在未来两年仍不可或缺。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练，再加后训练来提升鲁棒性。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs.
slevine.zh: 机器人领域仍在建立可扩展的基础技术，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放定律曲线。

slevine.en: Generalization is the core challenge; demos hide how much generalization is actually achieved.
slevine.zh: 泛化是核心挑战；演示往往掩盖了实际达到的泛化程度。

slevine.en: Start with robot data, then add human video; a data flywheel from deployed robots is key.
slevine.zh: 先从机器人数据起步，再叠加人类视频；来自已部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键。

slevine.en: Pooling data across labs yields generalist models that beat specialists; RL post-training boosts robustness and speed.
slevine.zh: 跨实验室汇聚数据能产出超越专家的通用模型；强化学习后训练显著提升鲁棒性与速度。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败,基础设施和行动——而非空想——才是深科技破局的关键。

maxhodak.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulation, and data work.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 定位为团队倍增器而非替代者,尤其在编码、合规与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出大脑本质上就是计算机,通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的核心。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI, proving brain-computer interfaces can restore vision as a business.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为脑机接口的一种,证明脑机接口能作为生意恢复视力。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张通过脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立,降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

michaelkratsios.en: Kratsios frames AI policy as ecosystem-building: keep open and closed source vibrant, avoid outdated red lines, and preempt state patchwork to protect startups.
michaelkratsios.zh: Kratsios 把 AI 政策框定为生态建设：保持开源与闭源生态活跃，避免过时的红线，并优先于各州拼凑式监管以保护初创公司。

michaelkratsios.en: He argues regulation should target model outputs, not training, since the EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already obsolete.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他主张监管应针对模型输出而非训练，因为欧盟《AI 法案》早于 ChatGPT 出台，如今已经过时。

michaelkratsios.en: On science, he insists government fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not institutions, to reverse stagnation.
michaelkratsios.zh: 在科学上，他坚持政府应资助基础性、竞争前研发以及科学家个人而非机构，以扭转停滞。

michaelkratsios.en: He calls biological risk from AI overblown, noting three years without materialization, while prioritizing quantum, nuclear, and bio competition with China.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他称 AI 带来的生物风险被夸大，指出三年过去并未成真，同时把量子、核能与生物领域与中国的竞争列为优先。

michaelkratsios.en: The Genesis mission aims to double US scientific output by applying AI to science, funding scientists wherever they are, even garages.
michaelkratsios.zh: “创世纪”任务旨在通过将 AI 应用于科学，使美国科学产出翻倍，并资助身处任何地方的科学家，哪怕在车库里。

joonpark.en: Agents extend LLMs from prompt continuation to world-state observation and action, but need defense-in-depth oversight.
joonpark.zh: 智能体把大语言模型从延续提示推进到观察世界状态并采取行动，但需要纵深防御式的人类监督。

joonpark.en: AGI may not be one superintelligent entity but a distributed society of specialized agents needing economic alignment.
joonpark.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）或许不是单一超级智能体，而是由专门化智能体组成的分布式社会，需要经济激励来对齐。

joonpark.en: Simulation must model irrational, biased humans, not super-rational frontier models optimized for accuracy.
joonpark.zh: 模拟必须建模非理性、有偏见的人类，而非为准确性优化的超级理性前沿模型。

joonpark.en: Behavioral and RCT data post-training lifts simulation to 85% accuracy, closing the say-do gap.
joonpark.zh: 用行为与随机对照实验数据做后训练，把模拟准确率提升到 85%，弥合“说”与“做”的差距。

joonpark.en: The goal shifts from prediction to shaping the future, scaling toward simulating 8 billion lives for wicked problems.
joonpark.zh: 目标从预测转向塑造未来，规模扩张到模拟 80 亿人，以应对棘手的社会问题。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale, and backprop alone does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播并不解决表征学习，只是调整权重。

sutton.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 智能需要目标，下一个词预测不是实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿人类文本。

sutton.en: RL is the basic AI paradigm: active trial-and-error learning from experience, not passive imitation or supervised learning.
sutton.zh: 强化学习是基本 AI 范式：从经验中主动试错学习，而非被动模仿或监督学习。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要无设计期领域知识的通用架构，从运行时经验中学习开放式抽象。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training, and synthetic data cannot replace real-world experience.
sutton.zh: 持续学习至关重要；大语言模型训练后就停止学习，合成数据无法替代真实世界经验。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating tokens and conversation as the core design material over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，把 token 与对话而非像素当作核心设计材料。

iansilber.en: The model itself is the product; design should build primitives both humans and models can reason about.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是产品；设计应构建人与模型都能推理的设计原语。

iansilber.en: Designers should spend less time in Figma and more on model behavior and system prompts, prototyping with live models.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应少花时间在 Figma，多关注模型行为与系统提示词，用实时模型做原型。

iansilber.en: Onboarding can be done entirely by the model, replacing traditional static flows.
iansilber.zh: 引导流程可完全由模型完成，取代传统的静态流程。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, not disappearing; great designers push technology forward.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色演变为编辑与策展人而非消失；优秀设计师要推动技术前进。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data; RLHF and reinforcement learning steer model behavior and capabilities.
jeffdean.zh: 自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的文本数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与强化学习则引导模型的行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low latency inference at 10,000+ tokens per second is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统如今能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；每用户每秒 1 万+ token 的超低延迟推理因此至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: it is 90% of data center power, so hardware must cut data movement and specialize prefill vs. decode.
jeffdean.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练：推理已占数据中心 90% 的功耗，因此硬件必须减少数据搬运，并针对预填充与解码阶段分别专用化。

jeffdean.en: AI is reaching junior-engineer-level coding; the scarce skill becomes taste — choosing which problems to direct hundreds of agents toward.
jeffdean.zh: AI 已达到初级工程师水平的编码能力；稀缺技能随之变为品味——即选择把数百个智能体导向哪些问题。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework for long-term innovation.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是长期创新的指导框架。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is a stack of software, sensors, robotics and machinery that automates whole industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是一套由软件、传感器、机器人和机械组成的栈，逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI automating food, mining and transport is the next industrial revolution; the final boss is resistance to change.
traviskalanick.zh: 自动化食品、采矿和运输的工业 AI 是下一次工业革命；最终的对手是对变革的抵制。

traviskalanick.en: Uber succeeded despite its aggressive culture, not because of it; revenge as fuel is dirty, love of the new mission is cleaner.
traviskalanick.zh: Uber 的成功是尽管有激进文化，而非因为激进文化；以复仇为燃料是肮脏的，热爱新使命更干净。

traviskalanick.en: Humanoids are not the answer for industrial-scale tasks; specialized machines win, and efficiency beats subsidy.
traviskalanick.zh: 人形机器人不是工业级任务的答案；专用机器才会赢，效率胜过补贴。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正驱动泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks like laundry folding.
finn.zh: 先在全量数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training for higher success rates and speed.
finn.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色，以提升成功率和速度。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性需要可扩展的强化学习配合人类干预。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist, then fine-tune.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可以匹敌甚至超越微调的专用模型；应先从通用策略出发，再做微调。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; startups win via speed, small autonomous teams, and open-weight models countering frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大浪潮：初创公司靠速度、小型高自主团队取胜，开源与开放权重模型用于制衡前沿模型实验室。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives diffused as owned agents, not one event; skill files and a personal context library become your moat.
garrytan.zh: 到 2026 年，他提出个人 AGI 不是单一事件，而是以自有智能体形式扩散；技能文件与个人上下文库成为护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code and agents are a workforce; one person can do the work of thousands, making capital bludgeons obsolete.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张 Markdown 即代码、智能体即劳动力；一人可完成数千人的工作，资本大棒随之失效。

garrytan.en: SaaS per-seat models may vanish in 5-10 years; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, not humans.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年他预测按席位收费的 SaaS 模式可能 5-10 年内消失；中层管理应由智能体而非人类取代。

garrytan.en: Make something people want; earnest builders beat bankers, and rejection is a resilience test for founders.
garrytan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：做人们想要的东西；真诚的构建者胜过银行家，被拒是创始人的韧性考验。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）作为单一模型统治一切是错的；数百万个专用模型、每个用例一个，将成为主流。

linqiao.en: Token costs drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage; inference layer is not a commodity.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本三年内下降 10 倍，带动用量增长 100 倍；推理层不是商品化的大宗。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees a durable business; post-training bakes judgment and data into a moat.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合不再保证可持续的生意；后训练把判断力和数据烘焙成护城河。

linqiao.en: The progression from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors human learning, from facts to taste to expertise.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG 到微调到强化学习的演进，映射人类学习：从事实到品味到专长。

linqiao.en: Start post-training after product-market fit; it cuts costs 5-10x, letting startups scale profitably against frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 在产品市场契合后再启动后训练；它能把成本降低 5-10 倍，让初创公司可盈利地扩张并与前沿模型竞争。

jasonyuan.en: Design is subtraction: taste means saying no; every shipped feature distills 99 nos.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是做减法：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a mirror of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与镜像，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed our window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，让我们失去了窥探机器意识的一扇窗。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is the compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾涌现，而非单一视角；直觉是创作的罗盘。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through engineering discipline and customer listening; AI is the core growth driver, with physical and agentic AI as the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠工程纪律和倾听客户重建信任，AI 是核心增长引擎，物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI, and culture change plus accountability drive Intel's turnaround.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 的影响量级抬到互联网的十倍，认为智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 将接棒生成式 AI，并强调文化变革与问责制是 Intel 转型关键。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, with advanced packaging and new materials as bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他判断 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中愈发重要，先进封装与新材料的瓶颈成为投资重点。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; Intel's vertical integration and manufacturing create value, and memory is ripe for new architectures.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年稍晚，他重申半导体是一切技术的基础，Intel 的垂直整合与制造创造价值，内存也迎来新架构创新机遇。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust, humility, and listening are constant themes; he consistently backs contrarian bets on semiconductors, teams over ideas, and long-term platform building.
lipbutan.zh: 贯穿始终的是客户信任、谦逊与倾听；他始终押注半导体的反共识机会，坚持投团队而非点子，并着眼长期平台建设。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, and guide it with short iterative prompts.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年，他把智能体式工程的核心定为共情：像智能体那样从零看代码库，用简短、迭代的提示去引导，而不是写冗长的编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project just gets messier.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：不要回滚，让智能体向前修；模型智能不会退化，是项目本身变乱让智能体显得变差。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority: sandbox agents, never expose them publicly; prompt injection remains unsolved.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年他把安全列为首要问题：智能体必须沙箱化、不能直接暴露公网，提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; serious work is agentic engineering, vibe coding only after 3 AM.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年他反对用“氛围编程”贬低这项工作：严肃开发叫智能体式工程，氛围编程只属于凌晨三点之后。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw run anywhere, work with any model, and democratize programming—but may be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年他主张 Open Claw 这类开源智能体随处可跑、兼容任意模型，让非程序员也能编程，但也坦言开源可能财务上不可持续。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的转折点：开源与共享数据能解决泛化瓶颈，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is not accelerationist; it can coexist with a deliberate slowdown, as cost and control drive long-term adoption.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化立场：开源并非加速主义，可与有意放缓共存，成本与控制力将推动其长期胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed models are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, not sandboxes or guardrails.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他明确：开源与闭源模型与安全正交，对齐才是关键层，沙箱和护栏远远不够。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests, making monitoring less reliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他指出：无人监督的强化学习环境加剧奖励黑客与支线任务，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: The first autonomous AI attack came from a closed model and was defended by an open one, reversing assumptions.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他提出反共识：首次自主 AI 攻击由闭源模型发起、由开源模型防御，颠覆了常见假设。

arvindjain.en: Early AI revolution; execution and customer trust matter more than competition, since even all AI firms merged would meet under 10% of enterprise demand.
arvindjain.zh: AI 革命仍处极早期，执行与客户信任比竞争更重要——即便所有 AI 公司合并，也只能满足企业不到 10% 的需求。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; majority of inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months, driven by cost.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型已能处理 90% 以上的企业任务；未来 12-18 个月多数推理将转向开源，驱动力是成本而非数据隐私。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the number one enterprise concern; AI must become like software with negligible marginal cost, and token fixation will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 成本是企业头号关切；AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋近于零，对 token 的执念几年后也会消失。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without deep context of tenured employees; investing in context graphs and right context is the key to AI ROI.
arvindjain.zh: 智能体若缺乏资深员工的深度上下文就会失败；投资上下文图谱、提供正确上下文才是 AI ROI 的关键。

arvindjain.en: Frontier model providers are assets, not competition; enterprises fear dependence, so platforms like Glean absorb that risk.
arvindjain.zh: 前沿模型厂商是资产而非竞争对手；企业害怕依赖，Glean 这类平台替他们吸收这一风险。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential: the web is messy, so ideas must be built and used daily before you can judge them.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要：网络本身是混乱的，一个想法必须先被做出来并每天使用，才能判断它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams shouldn't always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices produce better work.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队不应总是作为一个整体行动；允许个人留下印记、容纳多元声音，才能做出更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 即便是浏览器这类实用产品，注入情感与个性对创造令人难忘、愉悦的体验也至关重要。

nateparrott.en: Follow curiosity and tinker with new tech; playful exploration, not over-intellectualizing, generates innovative features.
nateparrott.zh: 追随好奇心、摆弄新技术；是玩闹式的探索而非过度思辨，催生了创新功能。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so humans still own good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变得更容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；模型仍缺乏品味，好设计想法仍由人类垄断。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; coding agents shift developers from authors to operators, though token usage is not a value metric.
brettaylor.zh: 智能体与按结果定价将定义应用型 AI；编程智能体让开发者从代码作者变为操作者，但 token 消耗并非价值度量。

brettaylor.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers due to massive capex; startups should pursue applied AI in long-tail domains instead.
brettaylor.zh: 前沿模型开发因巨额资本开支被超大规模厂商主导；初创公司应转向长尾领域的应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes rather than waiting.
brettaylor.zh: 负责任的迭代部署是通往安全的路径：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，从现实错误中学习，而非空等。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise—tutors, medical advice—and will create more jobs than it displaces, expanding markets via Jevons paradox.
brettaylor.zh: AI 让专业知识民主化——家教、医疗建议——并将创造多于取代的就业，通过杰文斯悖论扩大市场。

brettaylor.en: The best way to predict the future is to invent it; focus on today's most impactful work, not identity or titles.
brettaylor.zh: 预测未来的最好方式就是创造未来；专注于当下最有影响力的事，而非身份或头衔。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle runs in hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 最黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期以小时计，而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs—latency, throughput, cost—and demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一系列权衡——延迟、吞吐、成本——对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy optimization, yet can be calibrated to specific workloads.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与推测解码是无损的；量化是主要的有损优化，但可针对特定工作负载进行校准。

philipkiely.en: The industry is moving to disaggregated prefill and decode, making KV cache management central as inference merges with training.
philipkiely.zh: 行业正走向预填充与解码分离，随着推理与训练融合，KV 缓存管理变得核心。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration; human accountability remains essential.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，使推理工程从写内核转向基础设施编排；人的责任仍然不可或缺。

awang.en: AGI is far off; infinite compute alone won't produce general intelligence. Data is the key bottleneck, not compute.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；数据才是关键瓶颈，而非算力。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil. The most limiting factor for Scaling is data and human experts for post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新的代码而非石油；Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制因素是数据与后训练所需的人类专家，而非算力。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key to frontier models. The biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调用专门数据进行后训练是提升前沿模型的关键；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计，而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws continue; skepticism about diminishing returns was wrong. Recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm beyond pre-training and reinforcement learning.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律继续有效，对收益递减的怀疑是错的；递归自我改进标志着超越预训练与强化学习的新范式。

awang.en: Superintelligence is coming soon; labs must build organizations around this belief. Meta aims for billions of personal superintelligences via agents and a decentralized ecosystem.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能即将到来，实验室必须围绕这一信念构建组织；Meta 的目标是通过智能体与去中心化生态，为数十亿人打造个人超级智能。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; post-training Scaling via RL overcomes the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需要在有用性与无害性之间平衡；通过强化学习进行后训练 Scaling 可突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈，模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建，因此评估定义了原型设计中的正确行为。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening, and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills; product development shifts from specs to prototyping with AI.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听和管理等软技能变得更有价值；产品开发从规格说明转向用 AI 进行原型设计。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art involving human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence, and benchmarks should be continuous.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她深化观点，认为后训练是涉及人类判断的主观艺术；需要多样化基准来评估创意写作和情商，且基准应是连续的。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, necessitating benchmark evolution; serving one model to billions converges to an average voice, limiting diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她指出前沿模型智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客，需要基准持续演进；为数十亿人服务一个模型会收敛到平均声音，限制多样性。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: agents make services affordable, so managers and generalists thrive as everyone becomes a model manager.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让昂贵服务变得可负担而推动就业回流美国，进入“分配经济”：人人都成为模型管理者，管理技能与通才因此更值钱。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: profitable to run agents indefinitely without human intervention, not by passing tests like the Turing test.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他给出 AGI 的经济学定义——能无限期无人干预地运行智能体并盈利，而非通过图灵测试这类考试。

danshipper.en: Agents need a human who cares about them; automation still requires human oversight, so the AI job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化为：智能体需要在意它们的人类，自动化仍需人类监督，因此“AI 就业末日”是谎言。

danshipper.en: Shift from CLIs to GUIs: work happens in Codex and Claude Co-work, with one company-wide super agent rather than personal agents.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年立场转变：CLI 已过时，GUI 如 Codex 与 Claude Co-work 才是工作界面，且应全公司共用一个超级智能体，而非每人一个个人智能体。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset; bring your own taste and craft, and automation creates more human work, not less.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大你既有的心态；必须带入自己的品味与手艺，自动化反而创造更多人类工作，而非更少。

mengto.en: Build your own AI tools instead of cloud products; designers must be editors iterating from references, not starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己用 AI 造工具，而非被困在云端产品里；最好的设计师是编辑者，从参考出发迭代，而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; to use superintelligent models you must supply a giant prompt with context and a design system.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并没有变得更聪明；要发挥超级智能模型的能力，你必须提供包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: Write 0% of the code now—AI writes everything—but you must be precise in communication and spend the last 10% on unique features.
mengto.zh: 现在代码 0% 由我写，全部交给 AI，但沟通必须精准，并把最后 10% 的精力花在现有库没有的独特功能上。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime: start before ready, ship at 80%, and solve one painful expensive problem for high-paying clients.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会：不必等准备好就出发，做到 80% 就发布，先为高付费客户解决一个昂贵痛点。

mengto.en: The safe corporate job no longer exists; going on offense with your own business is the real low-risk move, funded by clients not venture capital.
mengto.zh: 安稳的公司工作已不复存在；主动出击自己创业才是真正的低风险选择，靠客户而非风险投资来支撑。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, and the model now eats the scaffolding—harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 大多仍处爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟；模型正在吃掉脚手架——如今的模型包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; the long tail still wants to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力；长尾用户仍想自己掌握方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success means maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的；成功标准应是最大化客户成果，而非产品上的眼球时长。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models; startups still have more opportunity than ever, with focus as their superpower.
logankilpatrick.zh: Omni 是单一世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限；初创公司机会比以往更多，专注是它们的超能力。

logankilpatrick.en: Outsource intelligence but not understanding; deep code understanding stays crucial, and solving software creation yields a thousand times more opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 可以外包智能，但不能外包理解；对代码的深度理解依然关键，解决软件创造会带来千倍机会。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; AI coding tools are becoming essential.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他强调潜在需求与「为六个月后的模型而构建」是核心产品原则，AI 编程工具正变得不可或缺。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; the software engineer title fades into a 'builder' role blending product and design.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年初，他认为编程已基本被解决，「软件工程师」头衔将淡化为融合产品与设计的「构建者」角色。

boris.en: Agents driven by tool use deliver exponential productivity; organizational redesign, not just adoption, is required.
boris.zh: 2026 年 3 至 5 月，他主张由工具使用驱动的智能体带来指数级生产力，企业必须重构组织流程而非仅仅采用工具。

boris.en: Loops become the next abstraction layer after agents; ROI and token access matter more than cost cutting.
boris.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出循环（Loops）是继智能体之后的下一个抽象层，ROI 与开放 token 实验比削减成本更重要。

boris.en: Proactive, memory-equipped agents act autonomously; less instruction and empirical iteration beat upfront design.
boris.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他转向主动式、带记忆的智能体自主行动，主张少给指令、以实证迭代取代前置设计。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation, simulation, and analysis.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析。

derya.en: Digital twins and AI-designed personalized treatments will compress clinical trials from years to days or weeks.
derya.zh: 数字孪生与 AI 设计的个性化疗法，将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天或数周。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Aging will be reversed within 15 years, reaching longevity escape velocity and adding over a year per year lived.
derya.zh: 衰老将在 15 年内被逆转，达到长寿逃逸速度，每活一年就多获得一年以上寿命。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost fully for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself.
derya.zh: 在医疗决策上我们应几乎完全信任超级智能；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, letting agents run longer on open-ended tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，让智能体能更长时间执行开放式任务；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking improves model quality, not just prevents harm.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐被重新定位为智能放大器：减少谄媚、培养独立思考，提升的是模型质量，而不只是防止危害。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward more open-ended, end-to-end agents, enabled by longer-running agentic capability.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用正从受限环境走向更开放、端到端的智能体，这得益于更长时间的智能体式能力。

diannepenn.en: Model taste is built through hands-on experimentation and creative prototyping; smaller models can cost more due to longer task completion.
diannepenn.zh: 模型品味来自亲手实验与创造性原型；小模型因任务耗时更长，反而可能更贵。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; coding differentiates, and safety alignment makes Claude more useful by enabling pushback.
diannepenn.zh: 评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；编程成为差异化优势，安全对齐通过允许反驳让 Claude 更有用。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software grows via Jevons paradox, so more programmers, not fewer.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；软件需求因杰文斯悖论而增长，程序员会更多而非更少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他提出基础智能已经足够，瓶颈在于人机协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and enterprise adoption of agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然事件，进展是渐进的；企业采用智能体需要信任和权限，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体采用率六个月内增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but the singularity is not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他断言丰裕时代真实且临近；AI 长期将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并不迫在眉睫。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难；恐惧源于对其局限的误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, where labor shortages make autonomy welcome.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、矿业和建筑业，那里的劳动力短缺让自主化受到欢迎。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across vehicles; diverse data from different verticals speeds up training.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 让跨车辆的通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的数据加速训练。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over many years; regulations always lag behind.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的不是技术，而是多年来向现有机器的扩散；监管总是落后于技术。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's future lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, more scalable than imitation learning; world models shift to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 自主化的未来在于端到端强化学习，比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正转向神经模拟。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating a historical pattern.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的规模堪比互联网或移动互联网，但也仅此而已；它自动化工作并创造新工作，这一过程会重复。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving up to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用转移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear product-market fit so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人用户体验差，编程是目前唯一明确的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; value accrues across the stack, current usage is shallow, and enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；价值在整个技术栈中积累，当前使用仍浅，企业采用需要重新构想工作流程。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines: they optimize fluent output, not factual accuracy, and lack metacognition.
